definition: to fail to remember someone or something; to stop thinking or worrying about someone or something; to give up a plan (forget about + something)
translation: quên (mất) điều gì; thôi không nghĩ đến nữa; từ bỏ kế hoạch
exampleSentence: I forgot about the meeting this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay tôi quên mất cuộc họp.

definition: to finish your studies at a university or college, or (in American English) at a high school (graduate from + a school/university)
translation: tốt nghiệp (đại học, cao đẳng, trung học)
exampleSentence: She graduated from university in 2020.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy tốt nghiệp đại học năm 2020.

definition: (of an event) to take place and affect someone or something, especially without being planned (something happens to somebody/something)
translation: xảy ra với ai/cái gì
exampleSentence: What happened to your phone?
exampleTranslation: Điện thoại của bạn bị sao vậy?

definition: to make it easier for someone to do something by doing part of their work or by giving them something they need (help somebody with something)
translation: giúp ai việc gì
exampleSentence: Can you help me with my homework?
exampleTranslation: Bạn giúp tôi làm bài tập được không?

definition: to turn your eyes towards something so that you can see it (look at + someone/something)
translation: nhìn vào ai/cái gì
exampleSentence: Look at this photo from our trip.
exampleTranslation: Nhìn bức ảnh chụp trong chuyến đi của chúng ta này.

definition: (formal) to take part in an activity or event; in everyday English people usually say take part in (participate in + something)
translation: tham gia vào, tham dự
exampleSentence: All students are encouraged to participate in the discussion.
exampleTranslation: Tất cả học sinh được khuyến khích tham gia thảo luận.

definition: to give someone something, or make it available to them, because they need or want it (provide somebody with something; not 'provide somebody something')
translation: cung cấp cho ai cái gì
exampleSentence: The hotel provides guests with free breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Khách sạn cung cấp bữa sáng miễn phí cho khách.

definition: to behave in a particular way or show a feeling because of something that has happened or been said; to become ill because of a drug or food (react to + something)
translation: phản ứng với, phản ứng lại điều gì; (cơ thể) phản ứng với thuốc hoặc thức ăn
exampleSentence: How did your boss react to the news?
exampleTranslation: Sếp của bạn phản ứng thế nào trước tin đó?

definition: to officially announce that you are leaving your job or an organization (resign from + a job/organization; resign as + a role)
translation: từ chức, xin thôi việc ở
exampleSentence: He resigned from the company last week.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy đã xin thôi việc ở công ty vào tuần trước.

definition: to try to find someone or something by looking very carefully; to try to find an explanation or solution (search for + somebody/something)
translation: tìm kiếm ai/cái gì; tìm cách giải quyết
exampleSentence: Rescue teams are searching for the missing hikers.
exampleTranslation: Đội cứu hộ đang tìm những người đi bộ đường dài bị mất tích.

definition: to make your mouth curve upwards at someone in a friendly way; to be amused by something (smile at + someone/something; not 'smile to')
translation: mỉm cười với ai; bật cười trước điều gì
exampleSentence: She smiled at the baby.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy mỉm cười với em bé.

definition: to pay regularly to receive a newspaper, a magazine or a service; to pay regularly to belong to an organization; to agree with an idea or belief (subscribe to + something)
translation: đăng ký dài hạn (báo, tạp chí, dịch vụ); đóng phí để làm hội viên; đồng tình với một quan điểm
exampleSentence: I subscribe to two online magazines.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đăng ký đọc hai tạp chí trực tuyến.

definition: to have a disease or medical condition, especially for a long time; to experience something unpleasant such as a shortage (suffer from + something); in everyday English people often say 'have' for a medical condition
translation: bị (bệnh), mắc phải; chịu đựng, gặp phải tình trạng khó khăn
exampleSentence: My grandfather suffers from back pain.
exampleTranslation: Ông tôi bị đau lưng.

definition: to speak about a subject or about doing something (talk about + something / doing something)
translation: nói về, bàn về điều gì
exampleSentence: We talked about our plans for the summer.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nói về kế hoạch cho mùa hè.

definition: to want something to happen or to have something, especially when it seems unlikely (wish for + something)
translation: ước, mong có được điều gì
exampleSentence: What would you wish for if you had three wishes?
exampleTranslation: Bạn sẽ ước điều gì nếu có ba điều ước?

definition: to do a job for a person, a company or an organization that pays you (work for + a person/company)
translation: làm việc cho ai/công ty nào
exampleSentence: My sister works for a travel agency.
exampleTranslation: Chị gái tôi làm việc cho một công ty du lịch.

definition: to feel anxious or unhappy about someone or something so that you think about them a lot (worry about + someone/something; not 'worry for')
translation: lo lắng về ai/điều gì
exampleSentence: I worry about my little brother.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lo lắng cho em trai mình.

definition: to not do or have something you enjoy, especially alcohol, usually for religious or health reasons (abstain from + something / doing something)
translation: kiêng, nhịn, kiềm chế không làm hoặc dùng điều gì
exampleSentence: You should abstain from eating before the blood test.
exampleTranslation: Bạn nên nhịn ăn trước khi xét nghiệm máu.

definition: to respect and like someone because they have done something you think is good (admire somebody for (doing) something)
translation: ngưỡng mộ ai vì điều gì
exampleSentence: I admire my grandmother for her courage.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngưỡng mộ bà tôi vì lòng dũng cảm của bà.

definition: to point a weapon or object at the person or place you want to hit; (of a plan or action) to be intended to achieve something (aim at + something; be aimed at + something). Note: 'aim to do something', not 'aim at doing'
translation: nhắm vào; (kế hoạch, hành động) nhằm vào, hướng tới mục tiêu
exampleSentence: The new rules are aimed at reducing traffic.
exampleTranslation: Những quy định mới nhằm giảm lượng xe cộ.

definition: to make a formal request to an organization such as a university or a council; to have an effect on or concern a person, group or situation (apply to + someone/something)
translation: nộp đơn đến (trường, cơ quan); áp dụng cho, liên quan đến ai/điều gì
exampleSentence: The discount only applies to new customers.
exampleTranslation: Ưu đãi này chỉ áp dụng cho khách hàng mới.

definition: (of the police) to take someone to a police station because they believe the person has done something illegal (arrest somebody for (doing) something)
translation: bắt giữ ai vì tội gì
exampleSentence: The police arrested him for stealing a car.
exampleTranslation: Cảnh sát đã bắt anh ta vì tội ăn cắp xe.

definition: to speak or write to someone to get an answer or information (ask (somebody) about something)
translation: hỏi về điều gì
exampleSentence: She asked about the price of the tickets.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy hỏi về giá vé.

definition: to use particular ideas or facts as the starting point for something; (be based on) to have something as its source (base something on something; be based on something)
translation: dựa trên, lấy cái gì làm cơ sở
exampleSentence: The film is based on a true story.
exampleTranslation: Bộ phim dựa trên một câu chuyện có thật.

definition: to talk too proudly about your abilities, achievements or possessions (boast about + something)
translation: khoe khoang về
exampleSentence: He is always boasting about his new car.
exampleTranslation: Anh ta lúc nào cũng khoe khoang về chiếc xe mới.

definition: to officially say that someone may be guilty of a crime (charge somebody with something; often passive: be charged with something)
translation: buộc tội, truy tố ai về tội gì
exampleSentence: He was charged with dangerous driving.
exampleTranslation: Anh ta bị buộc tội lái xe nguy hiểm.

definition: to hit someone or something that is moving in a different direction; to disagree strongly with a person or group (collide with + someone/something); in everyday English people often say 'run into'
translation: va chạm với, đâm vào; xung đột mạnh với
exampleSentence: The bus collided with a truck.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc xe buýt đâm vào một chiếc xe tải.

definition: to express an opinion about someone or something (comment on + someone/something)
translation: bình luận, nhận xét về
exampleSentence: Nobody commented on my new haircut.
exampleTranslation: Không ai nhận xét gì về kiểu tóc mới của tôi.

definition: to mistakenly think that one person or thing is another (confuse somebody/something with somebody/something)
translation: nhầm lẫn ai/cái gì với ai/cái gì khác
exampleSentence: People often confuse me with my twin brother.
exampleTranslation: Mọi người hay nhầm tôi với anh trai sinh đôi của tôi.

definition: to put something over a thing to hide, close or protect it; to form a layer over a surface (cover something with something)
translation: phủ, che, đậy cái gì bằng cái gì
exampleSentence: She covered the bowl with a plate.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đậy cái tô bằng một cái đĩa.

definition: to give more details or new information about something (elaborate on + something)
translation: nói rõ thêm, giải thích chi tiết hơn về
exampleSentence: Could you elaborate on that point?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể nói rõ thêm về điểm đó không?

definition: to leave a place when someone is trying to catch or stop you, or when there is danger (escape from + a place)
translation: trốn thoát khỏi, thoát khỏi
exampleSentence: Two prisoners escaped from the jail last night.
exampleTranslation: Hai tù nhân đã trốn khỏi nhà giam đêm qua.

definition: to give special attention to one person or thing (focus on + something)
translation: tập trung vào, chú trọng vào
exampleSentence: This course focuses on spoken English.
exampleTranslation: Khóa học này tập trung vào tiếng Anh nói.

definition: to stop being angry with someone, although they have done something wrong (forgive somebody for (doing) something)
translation: tha thứ cho ai vì điều gì
exampleSentence: I can't forgive him for lying to me.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không thể tha thứ cho anh ta vì đã nói dối tôi.

definition: to be told or find out a piece of information (hear about + something)
translation: nghe nói về, biết tin về điều gì
exampleSentence: How did you hear about this job?
exampleTranslation: Bạn biết đến công việc này bằng cách nào?

definition: to be told about someone or something (hear of + somebody/something)
translation: nghe nói đến, từng nghe về ai/cái gì
exampleSentence: I've never heard of that band.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chưa từng nghe nói đến ban nhạc đó.

definition: to keep something where other people cannot find it; to keep something such as a plan, a feeling or the truth secret (hide something from somebody)
translation: giấu cái gì khỏi ai
exampleSentence: He hid the letter from his parents.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy giấu lá thư khỏi bố mẹ.

definition: to suggest something in an indirect way, so that someone can guess your meaning (hint at + something)
translation: gợi ý, ám chỉ điều gì
exampleSentence: She hinted at a possible change in the schedule.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy ám chỉ rằng lịch có thể sẽ thay đổi.

definition: to find something funny and laugh while you talk or think about it (laugh about + something)
translation: cười khi nhắc đến hoặc nghĩ về điều gì
exampleSentence: We still laugh about that trip.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi vẫn còn cười mỗi khi nhắc lại chuyến đi đó.

definition: to laugh because you think someone or something is funny; to make fun of someone (laugh at + somebody/something)
translation: bật cười trước ai/điều gì; cười nhạo ai
exampleSentence: Everyone laughed at his joke.
exampleTranslation: Mọi người cười trước câu đùa của anh ấy.

definition: to cause something to happen; (of a path or door) to go towards a place (lead to + something/a place)
translation: dẫn đến, gây ra; (đường, cửa) dẫn tới
exampleSentence: Too much stress can lead to illness.
exampleTranslation: Quá nhiều căng thẳng có thể dẫn đến bệnh tật.

definition: to try to find someone or something (look for + somebody/something)
translation: tìm kiếm ai/cái gì
exampleSentence: I'm looking for my keys.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đang tìm chìa khóa của mình.

definition: to show something by holding up a finger or a thin object towards it; to hold something so that it is aimed at a person or thing (point at + something; point something at somebody)
translation: chỉ vào; chĩa cái gì vào ai
exampleSentence: The child pointed at the cake.
exampleTranslation: Đứa trẻ chỉ vào chiếc bánh.

definition: to stop something from happening, or to stop someone from doing something (prevent somebody/something (from) doing something); in everyday English people usually say 'stop'
translation: ngăn ai làm gì, ngăn điều gì xảy ra
exampleSentence: The rain prevented us from going out.
exampleTranslation: Cơn mưa ngăn chúng tôi ra ngoài.

definition: to keep a person or thing safe from harm, damage or illness (protect somebody/something from something)
translation: bảo vệ ai/cái gì khỏi điều gì
exampleSentence: Sunscreen protects your skin from the sun.
exampleTranslation: Kem chống nắng bảo vệ làn da của bạn khỏi ánh nắng.

definition: to answer someone by saying or writing something (reply to + something/someone); mainly used in written English, in everyday speech people usually say 'answer'
translation: trả lời (thư, câu hỏi, ai đó)
exampleSentence: I haven't replied to her message yet.
exampleTranslation: Tôi vẫn chưa trả lời tin nhắn của cô ấy.

definition: to make something happen; to cause something (result in + something)
translation: dẫn đến, gây ra
exampleSentence: The accident resulted in a long delay.
exampleTranslation: Vụ tai nạn dẫn đến sự chậm trễ kéo dài.

definition: to make someone or something safe from danger, harm or destruction (save somebody/something from something)
translation: cứu ai/cái gì khỏi điều gì
exampleSentence: The lifeguard saved the boy from drowning.
exampleTranslation: Nhân viên cứu hộ đã cứu cậu bé khỏi chết đuối.

definition: to criticize someone angrily, especially a child, for something they have done (scold somebody for (doing) something)
translation: la mắng ai vì điều gì
exampleSentence: My mother scolded me for coming home late.
exampleTranslation: Mẹ tôi mắng tôi vì về nhà muộn.

definition: to talk with someone in a conversation; to give a formal talk to an audience (speak to + somebody; speak to somebody about something); 'speak with somebody' is especially American English
translation: nói chuyện với ai; phát biểu trước ai
exampleSentence: I need to speak to the doctor.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần nói chuyện với bác sĩ.
